content:
Maya Chen: Sushi + board games this Wed after work? Thinking Izakaya on 3rd St, private room if we hit ~10. Start ~6:30 and move to the rooftop bar after. Who's in? 
Jordan Patel: In! 6:30 works for me. Vegetarian options ok? :thumbsup: 
Samira Ortiz: I can make it but need to leave early — 5:30 would be ideal for me. Also I'm GF, so please avoid soy cross-contact. 
Alex White: I'll join for drinks and games — might only show up ~8pm, but happy to bring Ticket to Ride or Codenames. 
Maya Chen: Good to know on GF Samira, will tell the place. If enough people prefer earlier we can move — quick poll from LunchBot below. 
LunchBot: Poll created. React with one of the time emojis and add food prefs: 
```
🟢 = 5:30pm  
🟡 = 6:30pm (default)  
🔵 = 7:00pm  
🍣 = sushi ok  
🥬 = need veg option  
🚫 = can't make 
```
Jordan Patel: 🟡 🍣 
Samira Ortiz: 🟢 🥬 
Alex White: 🔵 🍣 (I'll probably be late but put me down) 
Maya Chen: 🟡 🍣 — I'll book if we get 6+ by Tuesday noon. Anyone want to coordinate payment? I can handle a hold and we can Venmo/corp card split. 
Jordan Patel: Happy to Venmo my half. Also low-key vote for bringing the new Codenames: Pictures are cursed but it's fun. :laughing: 
Samira Ortiz: If we do 5:30 I can stay the whole time. If later, I'll still come for the food but leave before games. 
Alex White: I'll pick up a dessert (mochi?) and bring games. 
Maya Chen: Sweet. I'll DM the izakaya about GF options and reserve a table for 8 at 6:30 for now. If most react 🟢 we'll shift. Will post update here. :raised_hands:
